title: Owner sets branch protection and auto-merge
goal: main requires a PR and the CI check; auto-merge is allowed
acceptance: Branch protection on main: PR required, `check` required, enforce_admins, no force-push or deletion
Repository settings allow_auto_merge and delete_branch_on_merge on
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no consuming project's real data, secrets or tokens in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Planned 2026-11-25 in the upfront step plan: owner time only. Not a measurement.
